core: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and adherens junction maintenance
qualifier: podocyte nephrin junctions and cortical microtubules
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and podocyte junctions
rationale: All members concern establishing or maintaining epithelial polarity and cell-cell junctions; unlike the apical-junction/EMT and desmosome confusables, the theme includes podocyte nephrin interactions, podocyte migration and cortical microtubule organization.

qualifier: dietary lipid absorption and triglyceride-rich particles
name: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein assembly, remodeling, clearance
rationale: Members cover intestinal lipid uptake and the assembly, lipase remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL, whereas confusables center on HDL assembly and cholesterol efflux or on sterol/vitamin E transport.

core: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
qualifier: inhibitory metabotropic glutamate receptor and gap junction coupling
name: Neuronal calcium entry and intercellular signaling
rationale: A loose theme of neural signaling: calcium import and channel control, inhibitory mGluR signaling, electrical gap-junction and neuron-glia communication (visual behavior is a weak fit); it lacks the presynaptic GABA/kainate and connexin-trafficking content of its confusables.

core: Mesenchymal-epithelial signaling in gland branching morphogenesis
qualifier: prostate and salivary gland
name: Mesenchymal-epithelial signaling in prostate and salivary gland branching
rationale: Members describe reciprocal epithelial-mesenchymal signaling driving bud formation, branching and glandular epithelial differentiation in prostate and salivary gland (and limb bud), distinct from the lung-mesenchyme, genital-tract and pancreatic/kidney confusables.

qualifier: BAX/BAK oligomerization to apoptosome and SMAC-IAP release
name: Mitochondrial apoptosis execution via apoptosome and SMAC-IAP release
rationale: All members are the downstream intrinsic-apoptosis steps from BAX/BAK oligomerization and apoptotic factor release to apoptosome caspase activation and SMAC antagonism of IAPs, whereas confusables cover upstream BH3-only activation and MOMP regulation.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated cargo targeting
name: Mitophagy via PINK1-Parkin and receptor-mediated cargo targeting
rationale: Members concern removal of damaged mitochondria by PINK1-PRKN and receptor-mediated mitophagy with cargo delivery to autophagosomes, unlike confusables focused on mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein localization or on pexophagy and autophagosome biogenesis.

qualifier: enterohepatic transport, signaling and secretion rather than synthesis
name: Bile acid transport, recycling, signaling and secretion control
rationale: Members cover bile acid transport and recycling, receptor signaling, nuclear-receptor feedback on synthesis and secretion, whereas confusables are dominated by the bile acid synthesis routes and other ABC-transporter lipid or xenobiotic export.

qualifier: oncogenic PTEN and ALK transcriptional regulation
name: PAX3 targets and oncogenic transcriptional regulation
rationale: Three members are PAX3 target/motif gene sets and the other two are cancer-relevant transcriptional regulation (PTEN gene, ALK nuclear events); confusables are RUNX3, CDH1 and cell-cycle-arrest transcription programs without PAX3.

qualifier: cGMP/nitric oxide vasodilation and renal natriuresis
name: Blood pressure lowering via cGMP vasodilation and natriuresis
rationale: Members concern reduction of systemic and pulmonary blood pressure through cGMP/NO signaling, reduced vasoconstriction and renal sodium and water excretion, unlike the renin-angiotensin pressor and smooth muscle contraction confusables.

qualifier: proline synthesis and catabolism
name: Glutamate-family amino acid metabolism centered on proline
rationale: Members are general amino acid metabolic terms plus proline biosynthesis and catabolism, whereas confusables center on glycine/glyoxylate, serine/vitamin B6 or glutamate/glutamine nitrogen metabolism.

qualifier: gap junction electrical coupling and negative regulation of rate and contraction
name: Cardiac gap junction coupling and negative regulation of contraction
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte electrical coupling via gap junctions, membrane potential and calcium-release control with negative regulation of heart rate and contraction, distinct from confusables on positive inotropy, SR calcium handling or action potential phases and ion channels.

qualifier: with lysophospholipid hydrolysis
name: Phosphatidic acid, acylglycerol synthesis and lysophospholipid hydrolysis
rationale: Members cover synthesis of phosphatidic acid, mono-, di- and triacylglycerols and DAG/TAG remodeling plus LPC/LPE hydrolysis, unlike confusables on glycerol metabolism, phospholipid class synthesis, triglyceride lipolysis or PC regulation.

qualifier: toxins and phytochemicals by CYP, FMO and conjugating enzymes
name: Xenobiotic and phytochemical detoxification by phase I/II enzymes
rationale: Members describe oxidation (CYP, FMO), methylation, acetylation and sulfonation of xenobiotics, toxins and plant compounds, whereas confusables are specific drug ADME with amino acid conjugation or ethanol/aldehyde oxidation.

qualifier: translation termination and nonsense-mediated decay
name: mRNA polyadenylation, translation termination and nonsense-mediated decay
rationale: Members link mRNA 3'-end cleavage/polyadenylation with translation termination, non-stop ribosome release and NMD, while confusables cover mRNA stabilization/decapping, histone mRNA processing or splicing and nuclear export.

qualifier: mammary gland and placental trophoblast
name: Mammary gland and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members cover mammary gland branching, lineages, lactation and involution together with trophoblast differentiation, placental labyrinth and early embryo-maternal processes, unlike prostate/genital-tract or stem-cell-maintenance confusables.

qualifier: BCL-2 family control of outer membrane permeabilization
name: Intrinsic apoptosis via BCL-2 family and mitochondrial permeabilization
rationale: Members span BH3-only protein activation, BAX/BAK, MOMP and cytochrome c release regulation through apoptosome and SMAC, distinct from confusables on execution-phase DNA fragmentation, oxidative-stress triggers, p53 transcription or extrinsic/necroptotic signaling.

qualifier: tetrahydrofolate interconversion and folate transport
name: Folate transport and tetrahydrofolate one-carbon metabolism
rationale: All members concern folate/pterin uptake, metabolism and formyl-THF/formate one-carbon interconversion, unlike the methionine cycle and nucleotide biosynthesis confusables.

core: Chromatin remodeling in DNA repair and replication
qualifier: ADP-ribosylation control
name: Nucleosome remodeling in DNA repair and replication with ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members concern nucleosome assembly/disassembly and chromatin access during replication and repair, with regulation of protein ADP-ribosylation and de-ADP-ribosylation distinguishing them from CHD/NuRD/BAF transcriptional remodeler and double-strand-break confusables.

core: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA/rRNA modification
name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA/rRNA modification
rationale: Members span mitochondrial DNA replication, transcription, RNA processing and translation together with tRNA/rRNA processing and modification and translational fidelity, unlike confusables on nuclear Pol I/III transcription, splicing, protein methylation or telomerase/NMD.

qualifier: apical membrane and membrane rafts
name: Protein targeting to apical surface and membrane rafts
rationale: Members concern positive and negative control of protein delivery to the cell surface, membrane rafts and apical domain (with the CORO1A-DEF6 network), unlike confusables on basolateral/Golgi secretion, CFTR trafficking or Rho GTPase cycles.

qualifier: fructose-2,6-bisphosphate and pentose-phosphate shunt
name: Fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control of glycolysis and pentose-phosphate flux
rationale: Members describe fructose bisphosphate metabolism regulating glycolysis and pentose-phosphate shunt flux, while confusables are lactate fermentation, hexokinase/glucose catabolism or p53/mTORC1 metabolic programs.

core: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability and translation control
qualifier: ADAR editing and PKR/type I interferon restraint
name: mRNA stability control and ADAR editing restraining interferon response
rationale: Members combine 3'-UTR-mediated mRNA stabilization/destabilization and translational silencing with ADAR A-to-I editing, PKR and negative regulation of type I interferon signaling, which the ARE-decay and OAS antiviral confusables lack.

qualifier: with mitochondrial dynamics
name: Selective organelle autophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
rationale: Members cover mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy and nucleophagy with autophagosome regulation plus mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein localization, unlike confusables on lysosome fusion, mitochondrial import or chaperone-mediated autophagy.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of carboxylic acids
name: Drug metabolism with amino acid conjugation of carboxylates
rationale: Members are ADME of specific drugs plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing them from confusables on xenobiotic/toxin oxidation by CYP, FMO and sulfonation.

core: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization
qualifier: adipocyte
name: Adipocyte lipid droplet triglyceride storage and mobilization
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown, triglyceride storage and lipolysis and lipophagy in adipocytes, unlike confusables on glycerolipid synthesis, PDE3B/fatty acid transport or LXR lipogenic gene regulation.
